title: An injective endomorphism of a finite free module has cokernel with zero dual
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $n\ge0$ an integer. If $\psi:R^{\oplus n}\to R^{\oplus n}$ is an injective $R$-linear map of finite free $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module], then $\mathrm{Hom}_R(\mathrm{Coker}(\psi),R)=0$; equivalently, the transpose $\psi^t:R^{\oplus n}\to R^{\oplus n}$ is injective.
